test_title: PYST 14: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the informationgiven in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logicall follow(s) from the

 statements.

 Statements:

Some water is pink.

All pink are buildings.

All buildings are tall.

 Conclusions:

(I) Some pink is water.

(II) Some buildings are pink.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e576a48b8227c57d034c4e70b3bd8c1017cc76c2ab3ac9714d6616b129d2957.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some pink is water → Follow (As some water is pink. As some part of water is common with pink, therefore it is true.)

(II) Some buildings are pink → Follow (As all pink are buildings. As whole pink comes in building, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
